title: Select widget options

comments.body: @Maaark To ease the understanding of your requirement, could you do a mockup `<select>` element in a jsFiddle showing what you to to accomplish and explain what are the refinements you would want to do for the options of your select? Thanks

Sure, is http://codepen.io/Maaark123/pen/EyvVbZ clear enough? 

About my alpha char question, skip that for now, I will transform them to numbers so I can use the same widget.
@vvo Forgot to mention that we want to use the 'end' option as well. Updated my select example. http://codepen.io/Maaark123/pen/EyvVbZ

That isn't completely what we want. 

We want to auto hide the options when there are no records matching the value.
And we want to work with start and end values.
We want to have more control over the template, like the above code for the select widget.

@vvo So basically https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/src/widgets/numeric-refinement-list/numeric-refinement-list.js in a select element and auto hide of non existent options in the initial state.
